Modern 3-Bedroom Own Title Home with Mountain Views

Situated in the secure and well-maintained Squirrel Close, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom own title home offers comfortable family living in a convenient Stellenbosch location.

Designed for easy living, the home features a generous open-plan lounge and dining area that flows effortlessly to a private courtyard, creating the perfect space for entertaining friends and family. The well-sized kitchen offers ample cupboard space and room for your everyday appliances.

Upstairs, the spacious main bedroom enjoys air conditioning and direct access to a large covered balcony with beautiful mountain views. Two modern bathrooms serve the home.

Whether you're looking for your first home, a family residence or an investment property, this home offers an excellent combination of space, security and value.
